caption: The video showcases a close-up of an automated assembly machine with a fixed camera. A green vibratory bowl feeder filled with small brass components sits at the top right, while a worn green concrete floor fills the background. At the center, a vertical actuator head built around a white pneumatic cylinder with orange air tubing and black cables holds a downward probe. For the first part of the clip this head remains lowered above an open two-jaw work fixture, across which a red laser line is projected. The head then lifts vertically, revealing a small orange component seated in the fixture, and stays raised for a time. Afterward the whole central gantry block translates leftward, carrying the head off the fixture and over a horizontal aluminum plate with four holes, where it lowers slightly. On the left, a white-tipped nozzle is positioned above a small part that glows orange throughout, and a control panel with a red digital readout sits at the bottom right.
